description: Overview: HAQATHON 2.0 – Hack the Next Quantum Decade HAQATHON 2.0 is a 24-hour quantum computing hackathon organized as part of PLUS Qiskit Fall Fest 2026 at RGUKT Srikakulam , celebrating a decade of quantum computing on the cloud and bringing together the next generation of quantum innovators. The hackathon provides an exciting platform for students, developers, researchers, and quantum enthusiasts to come together, collaborate, experiment, and build innovative solutions using the rapidly evolving field of quantum computing. Participants will work in teams to explore and develop solutions using technologies and approaches such as: ️ Quantum Computing & Qiskit Quantum Algorithms Quantum Machine Learning Hybrid Quantum–Classical Computing Quantum Optimization Quantum Applications & Emerging Technologies The challenge goes beyond simply writing code. Participants are encouraged to identify meaningful real-world problems, develop innovative ideas, and explore how quantum technologies can contribute to solving them . From conceptualizing an idea to implementing and presenting a working solution, HAQATHON 2.0 provides participants with an opportunity to experience the complete journey of quantum innovation while learning from peers, mentors, and fellow quantum enthusiasts. Registration: Registration Fee: ₹100 per participant The registration fee will be collected upon arrival at the venue . Whether you are experienced in quantum computing or taking your first steps into the quantum world, HAQATHON 2.0 is an opportunity to learn, build, collaborate, and push the boundaries of what is possible with quantum technology. For further details and updates: www.qffrguktsklm.in Think Quantum. Build the Future. Hack the Next Quantum Decade.
organiser: Rajiv Gandhi University of Knowledge Technologies (RGUKT) - IIIT Srikakulam

Overview:

HAQATHON 2.0 – Hack the Next Quantum Decade

HAQATHON 2.0 is a 24-hour quantum computing hackathon organized as part of PLUS Qiskit Fall Fest 2026 at RGUKT Srikakulam, celebrating a decade of quantum computing on the cloud and bringing together the next generation of quantum innovators.

The hackathon provides an exciting platform for students, developers, researchers, and quantum enthusiasts to come together, collaborate, experiment, and build innovative solutions using the rapidly evolving field of quantum computing.

Participants will work in teams to explore and develop solutions using technologies and approaches such as:

  • ️ Quantum Computing & Qiskit
  • Quantum Algorithms
  • Quantum Machine Learning
  • Hybrid Quantum–Classical Computing
  • Quantum Optimization
  • Quantum Applications & Emerging Technologies

The challenge goes beyond simply writing code. Participants are encouraged to identify meaningful real-world problems, develop innovative ideas, and explore how quantum technologies can contribute to solving them.

From conceptualizing an idea to implementing and presenting a working solution, HAQATHON 2.0 provides participants with an opportunity to experience the complete journey of quantum innovation while learning from peers, mentors, and fellow quantum enthusiasts.

Registration:

Registration Fee: ₹100 per participant

The registration fee will be collected upon arrival at the venue.

Whether you are experienced in quantum computing or taking your first steps into the quantum world, HAQATHON 2.0 is an opportunity to learn, build, collaborate, and push the boundaries of what is possible with quantum technology.

For further details and updates:
www.qffrguktsklm.in

Think Quantum. Build the Future. Hack the Next Quantum Decade.
